note: WAEC Islamic Studies round 3 (Round 21 top-up): hadith science (isnad and matn, Bukhari and Muslim, the Sunan works, Nawawi's Forty), wudu invalidators, khuff wiping, tayammum, qiblah, Maghrib rak'ahs, Jumu'ah and khutbah, salat al-kusuf, zakah hawl, nisab 85 g, 2.5% rate, zakat al-fitr timing, sadaqah, qada for the sick and traveller, suhur and iftar, hajj rites in order (ihram and talbiyah, Arafat on 9 Dhul-Hijjah, Muzdalifah, tawaf, sa'y, rami al-jamarat), umrah's open season, nikah witnesses, mahr, iddah, khul, parents next to worship, aqiqah, faraid shares (wife 1/8, parents 1/6), debts before shares, riba, defect-free sales, cave Hira, Iqra, 622 CE, Hudaybiyyah, the four caliphs, Uthman's compilation, tawhid, shirk, articles of iman, ihsan, Muharram and laylat al-qadr. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-2, NECO IRS and the JAMB pool.
